calls.title: Dassault & GrowthBook Check in
calls.summary: The conversation centered around preparing for growth discussions and testing rollouts, which will commence post-vacation in September due to the holiday season in France. Nicolas Coze explained the delay caused by staff unavailability during July and August, setting expectations for strategic decisions in early Q4. James Shannon confirmed he would send a recorded demonstration meeting to align stakeholder knowledge. To prepare a value-based quote, critical inputs such as planned experiments and website visitor counts were requested, with Nicolas agreeing to provide these post-vacation. Emphasis was placed on linking the tool’s impact to measurable revenue drivers, particularly content generation outputs. The meeting concluded with a commitment to pause discussions until after summer, maintaining momentum with follow-up actions.
calls.keywords: product testing, growth strategy, demo recording, pricing quote, lead generation, business metrics
calls.action_items:
**James Shannon**
Send Nicolas Coze the recorded demonstration meeting from June 25th for his review (05:16)
Send Nicolas an email including the demo recording and a list of key information needed to prepare a pricing quote, such as number of experiments, users, and relevant business metrics (09:03)

**Nicolas Coze**
Review the demo recording sent by James to better understand the product capabilities and prepare for further discussions (05:17)
Compile and send an email with the number of planned experiments, number of users, and key business metrics such as website visitors, demo bookings, and average deal size to assist in preparing a pricing quote (08:20)
